$about: Curator data for the Sulcalibur home probe. Edit this file, then run: node probe.mjs build

intake.question: What should the work feel like when it is right?
intake.help: Choose up to three. These are the brand's centre of gravity, not the page's mood.
intake.recommendWhy: The existing art is watercolour, the body face is Lora, and the writing is personal.

options.label: Warm
options.note: Inviting, human, not glossy.

options.label: Exact
options.note: Measured, edited, nothing loose.

options.label: Playful

options.label: Serious
options.note: Weight without pomposity.

options.label: Handmade

options.label: Technical
options.note: Precise, systematic, legible.

options.label: Luxurious
options.note: Space, restraint, expensive quiet.

options.label: Plain
options.note: No performance; the work speaks.

pairs.question: How should the front page be organised?
pairs.hint: Ignore colour and typeface. Which structure would you keep?

options.label: Chronological
options.alt: A tall single-column page: a narrow column of date-stamped posts with photographs inline and a small sidebar of book covers.
options.vocab: One column, date-led, newest first; images sit inside the prose.
options.avoid: an undated stream where the best work scrolls away
options.note: Single column, date-stamped entries, inline images with captions, one nav row, no sidebar. The page is the feed.

options.label: Curated index
options.alt: A warm, dense front page: a short biography followed by shelves of book covers, lettering and selected work.
options.vocab: A curated front page: a short introduction, then shelves of books and work.
options.avoid: a front page that hides the newest work behind a menu
options.note: Bio, book, covers, selected work: many entry points, warm colour, organised as shelves rather than a timeline.

options.label: Image first

options.vocab: A full-bleed photograph, one serif line over it; almost no chrome.
options.avoid: a first screen that is a picture with nothing to read
options.note: Full-bleed photograph, a single serif line, a small scroll cue. The image introduces the place.

options.label: Statement first
options.alt: A pale page with a letterspaced wordmark at the top, a centred three-line statement, and photography beginning below the fold.
options.vocab: A letterspaced wordmark and a centred statement; photography starts below the fold.
options.avoid: a first screen that could belong to any studio
options.note: Wordmark, centred statement, generous white, image grid below. Type introduces, images follow.

pairs.question: How much should a screen hold?
pairs.hint: Both are publications. Count the competing elements, not the content.

options.vocab: A three-up card grid, one headline each, wide margins.

pairs.hint: Look at whether the images have words attached.

options.alt: A magazine page with a large lead video still and rows of image tiles, each tile carrying a title and a category label.

options.avoid: a caption on every tile until the page reads as a database

options.label: Bare images

options.vocab: A masonry of images with no captions; the collection is the page.
options.avoid: a gallery where nothing says what you are looking at
options.note: Masonry, images only, no captions; the grid is the content.

facts.text: The type is Arco (display), BalooSul (headings and UI) and Lora (body).
The palette is warm linen and dusk, with lavender for links, coral for one CTA and gold for metadata.
The Eagle library holds 5,495 usable captures; 5,216 came from five galleries.
The home page is 1,721 lines and runs three overlapping feeds: blog, micro-posts and photography.
`post_type: 'pinned'` already exists, so a start-here piece needs no new field.

intakeClose.question: Is this understanding shared?
intakeClose.help: The references are chosen from these answers. If something is wrong, reopen it before the images.

output.systemNote: This file is the **direction layer** for this page. The system layer stays in `tokens.json`, `main.css` and `design.md`.
output.assetsNote: `ArtSlot` stays the only way an image reaches the page. The probe changes role and captioning, not the slot contract.
agentBrief: Build the structure, not the references. Borrow principles; never copy a layout wholesale.
Every content image goes through `ArtSlot`/`Plate`; alt required, no layout shift on swap.
Do not add motion beyond the intensity values above; gate it behind `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Use the existing tokens. If a parameter is missing, add it to `tokens.json` and `main.css` together.
Before claiming done: `pnpm tokens:check`, `pnpm typecheck`, render at 1440 and 390, and `?art=audit` with zero unspecced slots.

conflictNotes.spine:chronological: A is a ladder (Start here → Latest → Archive). A pure date feed removes the first rung.
conflictNotes.opening:image: A opens on a statement, not a photograph. An image-first hero changes the first screen.
conflictNotes.density:high: A is one thing per screen. High density adds competing modules and a margin column.
conflictNotes.media:bare-image: A commits to plated, captioned images for every content image.
conflictNotes.typeVoice:expressive: A reserves Arco for the wordmark and one hero line; type does not become the page.
conflictNotes.recirculation:curated: A ends on an archive index, not a related-items shelf.

spine.chronological: Order the home by date. One column, newest first; no Start here shelf. `LadderRow` is not used.
spine.curated: Build a three-rung ladder: Start here → Latest → Archive. `LadderRow` + `IndexList`; nothing depends on publish order.

opening.image: First screen is one image with one line over it. Hero art slot at 16:9; no wordmark block above it.
opening.statement: First screen is the wordmark and a statement of at most three lines. No hero image above the fold; `type.5xl`.

density.high: Six to eight entry points above the fold; a margin column is allowed. Section rhythm `spacing.6`.
density.low: At most three entry points above the fold; no sidebar. Section rhythm `spacing.9`–`spacing.10`.

media.captioned-grid: Every image is a `Plate`: alt required, caption required (fall back to alt until `featured_image_caption` exists).
media.bare-image: Images may stand alone in a grid; alt still required, captions optional. Do not mix bare and plated images on one screen.

typeVoice.expressive: One oversized display line per page (`font.display`, up to `type.5xl`); colour may structure sections.
typeVoice.quiet: Display only at section openers; body `font.body` at `type.md`, measure 62–68ch; colour is an accent.

recirculation.archive: End with `IndexList`: years and months, every item. No related-posts carousel.
recirculation.curated: End with 3–5 related items and a one-line reason each. No exhaustive archive on the home page.

firstRung.pinned: Rung 1 is a pinned piece (`post_type: 'pinned'`), falling back to the newest post.
firstRung.newest: Rung 1 is the newest post; the page stays alive without curation.
firstRung.featured: Rung 1 is a featured project; the work leads and the writing follows.
firstRung.intro: Rung 1 is a short introduction; the shelves follow it.

archivePlace.home: The archive is a rung on the home page, not a link to somewhere else.
archivePlace.own-page: The home ends with a link to `/writing`; the exhaustive archive lives there.
archivePlace.both: A recent slice on the home; everything at `/writing`.

secondColumn.now: The second column carries now / reading.
secondColumn.events: The second column carries events or talks.
secondColumn.none: No second column. This overrides the dense choice: keep the page airy.

captionSource.cms: Add `featured_image_caption` to Directus before captions ship. Until then, fall back to alt and say so.
captionSource.alt: Captions fall back to alt text and the UI says so. Do not invent captions.
captionSource.manual: Captions live in the post body; the media record stays uncaptioned.

heroArt.photo: The hero is a real photograph. Never generate it.
heroArt.existing: The hero is the existing meadow/cloud artwork at 16:9.
heroArt.commission: The hero slot stays pending until the illustration is commissioned; no placeholder art.

displayBudget.one: At most one display moment per page; everything else is reading type.
displayBudget.two: At most two display moments per page.
displayBudget.sections: One display moment per section; the page may become a specimen.

never.three-cards: No three equal cards in a row.
never.none: No extra bans beyond the direction contract.

density.low: One idea per surface: one card in social, one claim per slide, one object per print page.
density.high: Layered surfaces: carousels, deck grids, index-led pages.

typeVoice.expressive: One display line per surface: the social hook, the deck section opener, the print cover.
typeVoice.quiet: Text carries each surface: deck body at reading size, social led by the caption.

media.captioned-grid: Every image is labelled: social captions, deck figure notes, print captions.
media.bare-image: Images can stand alone: full-bleed deck covers, image-only posts.

opening.image: Lead with an image on every surface: first slide, cover, post.
opening.statement: Lead with a sentence on every surface: title slide, cover line, first post.

recirculation.archive: End with an index or a next step, never a carousel.
recirculation.curated: End with a small curated shelf, not an exhaustive list.

assets.effect: Full-bleed real photograph with one line over it; never generated.
Full-bleed existing artwork with one line over it.
Slot stays pending until the illustration is commissioned; no substitute.
Full-bleed image with one line over it; the source is not yet decided.
Stays behind the statement; it never becomes a standalone hero image.
Caption optional; alt still required. Do not strip the plated frame.
Caption from `featured_image_caption`; add the field first.
Caption written in the post body; the media record stays uncaptioned.
Caption falls back to alt and says so.
No captions; the grid is the content. Alt still names place and season.
Caption names place and season; alt carries the same information.

openQuestions: `featured_image_caption` does not exist in Directus; plates fall back to alt until the field is added.
`Start here` uses `post_type: 'pinned'`, falling back to newest. Confirm which post is pinned.
